lines: A voice trembling, wanting to touch
Misreading it, becoming myself
Wanting to become it, a bell that can't ring, even dying
Don't let it end until I've made sure
I just stayed silent
I bore it as long as I yearned
In a frozen field of view, burning up today
Good thing I left it unread, as a matter of principle
I could say it won't be alright
I wrote off the small pains, but
Meeting you, being forgiven
It won't ever come off
Even if that thing paints it over, dark and black
It will never be taken from me
Even an instant existence
Even unseen, it's here
Wanting to protect it — all of it is just the ego's worldly desire
Holding back, tossing my heart away
It's surely different, but
I've learned it, I've realized it
If the loneliness I was given is this precious
No need to doubt, no need to believe
Chain, keep going
Even the hackneyed rituals, performed so well
Dance to sharpening one another, countdown
Even soaked in a triangle of fate
Wherever I am, a place — I doubt it
Trained cells, break them down
Forgive that this life exists
Carrying everything I've seen until now
Living, letting myself be wounded
Wanting to protect it — all of it is just the ego's worldly desire
Holding back, tossing my heart away
It's surely different, but
I've learned it, I've realized it
If the loneliness I was given is this precious
No need to doubt, no need to believe
Chain, keep going
It won't ever come off
Even if that thing paints it over, dark and black
It will never be taken from me
Even in an instant world
Even untouched, it's here
Wanting it granted, wanting to win
All at the mercy of time
At the end I aimed for, where I arrived
I wonder if there's a loneliness that fills me there too
Having stopped, I understood too well
If the courage to choose differently is this precious
No need to doubt, no need to deceive one another
Chain, keep going
